title: Personal Checking: extended overdraft fee on an episode the linked savings account would have prevented
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to the bank-error review of the most recently posted extended overdraft fee on a Personal Checking account, where the debit that opened the negative episode has been identified. It decides whether an overdraft protection transfer would have paid that opening debit.

## Formal clauses

1. **Why it matters.** When the debit that opened the episode would have been paid by an overdraft protection transfer, the episode would never have begun, so the extended overdraft fee charged on it is a bank error.
2. **Which savings account, which balance.** For a refund decision under this review, coverage of the opening debit is judged on the savings account the checking account names as its overdraft protection link when the decision is made, by comparing that savings account's current balance at the time of the decision with the whole amount of the opening debit.
3. **When it would have been paid.** The opening debit would have been paid by a transfer when that linked savings tier is designated in the savings product terms as eligible to serve as an overdraft protection source and its current balance is at least the opening debit's amount.
4. **Only an identified opening debit.** This ground is judged only where the opening debit of the episode has been identified.

## Condition table

| Opening debit identified | Linked savings tier eligible as a source | Linked savings current balance compared with the whole opening debit | Reading on this ground |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | At least the debit's amount | Bank error |
| Yes | Yes | Less than the debit's amount | No bank error on this ground |
| Yes | No | Any | No bank error on this ground |
| Yes, but no overdraft link is named now | — | — | No bank error on this ground |
| No | — | — | This ground is not judged |

## Witness case (hypothetical figures)

The opening debit was 250.00 USD and left a shortfall of 90.00 USD on the day it posted. Today the linked savings account, on an eligible tier, holds 140.00 USD. Compared with the shortfall, 140.00 would look sufficient; compared with the whole opening debit of 250.00, as clause 2 requires, it is not, so there is no bank error on this ground. With 250.00 USD or more in the linked savings account today, there would be.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "judge the savings account that was linked when the episode began". **Correct basis:** the savings account named as the overdraft link when the decision is made, at its current balance.
